Native C++ extension interface, k-core decomposition, and property map access

cpp_extensions.Rd

Exposes rgraphtool's public C++ extension header (<rgraphtool.h>) for writing high-performance custom network algorithms in C++ via sourceCpp or downstream R packages declaring LinkingTo: rgraphtool, Rcpp, BH, together with built-in reference implementations of \(k\)-core decomposition (kcore_decomposition()) and weighted vertex strength (vertex_strength()).

Usage

kcore_decomposition(graph, deg = c("total", "out", "in"), checked = FALSE)

vertex_strength(graph, property, mode = c("total", "out", "in"),
  checked = FALSE)

rgraphtool_include_dir()

rgraphtool_extension_example(name = c("kcore", "weighted_degree"))

compile_cpp_extension(file = NULL, code = NULL, env = parent.frame(),
  rebuild = FALSE, verbose = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

graph

A graph created by graph_create.

deg

Degree definition for kcore_decomposition(): "total" (default, matching graph-tool's kcore_decomposition()), or "out"/"in" for directed graphs.

property

Character scalar naming an edge property attached to graph via graph_add_edges or graph_set_edge_property.

mode

Edge incidence mode for vertex_strength(): "total", "out", or "in" (undirected graphs support only "total").

checked

Logical; if TRUE, perform per-access bounds checking on vertex and edge property maps in C++; if FALSE (default), validate property map lengths once via get_unchecked() and use zero-overhead direct indexing inside hot loops.

name

Bundled C++ extension example name: "kcore" or "weighted_degree".

file

Path to a C++ source file (mutually exclusive with code).

code

Character vector of inline C++ source code (mutually exclusive with file).

env

Target R environment where exported C++ functions are assigned.

rebuild

Logical; force recompilation in sourceCpp.

verbose

Logical; print compiler invocation details.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to sourceCpp.

Details

Public C++ API (#include <rgraphtool.h>, namespace rgraphtool):

  • Zero-copy graph access: get_graph(SEXP obj) accepts either an rgraphtool_graph R object or its external pointer, returning Graph&. Inspection helpers include num_vertices(g), num_edges(g), is_directed(g), source(e, g), target(e, g), edge_index(e), out_degree(v, g), in_degree(v, g), total_degree(v, g), and checked_vertex(v, g).

  • Range-based graph iteration: vertices_range(g), edges_range(g), out_edges_range(v, g), in_edges_range(v, g), all_edges_range(v, g), out_neighbors_range(v, g), in_neighbors_range(v, g), and all_neighbors_range(v, g). For undirected graphs, out_edges_range(v, g) iterates all incident edges oriented with source == v.

  • Property maps (checked vs. unchecked): vertex_property_view(vec, g) wraps an R NumericVector or IntegerVector zero-copy in a bounds-checked VertexPropertyMap<T>; edge_property_view(g, name) wraps an attached edge property in a bounds-checked EdgePropertyMap<double> / ConstEdgePropertyMap<double>; make_vertex_property<T>(g, init) and make_edge_property<T>(g, init) allocate owning property maps. Calling .get_unchecked() verifies buffer capacity once against num_vertices(g) / num_edges(g) and returns a raw-pointer unchecked accessor for tight loops (analogous to graph-tool's PropertyMap.get_unchecked()).

Build requirements: Compiling C++ extensions requires a C++23-capable toolchain (matching rgraphtool's SystemRequirements: C++23) and the Rcpp and BH header packages. Downstream R packages can add LinkingTo: rgraphtool, Rcpp, BH and CXX_STD = CXX23 in src/Makevars.

Value

kcore_decomposition() returns an integer vector of length \(N\) containing each vertex's core number. vertex_strength() returns a numeric vector of length \(N\). rgraphtool_include_dir() and rgraphtool_extension_example() return normalized file paths. compile_cpp_extension() returns the result of sourceCpp invisibly.

Examples

g <- graph_create(6L, directed = FALSE)
graph_add_edges(g, rbind(c(1, 2), c(2, 3), c(3, 1), c(3, 4), c(4, 5)),
                properties = list(w = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)))
kcore_decomposition(g)
#> [1] 2 2 2 1 1 0
vertex_strength(g, "w")
#> [1] 4 3 9 9 5 0
rgraphtool_include_dir()
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpoEurwN/temp_libpathdc56e3bf35757/rgraphtool/include"
rgraphtool_extension_example("kcore")
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpoEurwN/temp_libpathdc56e3bf35757/rgraphtool/examples/extensions/kcore_extension.cpp"
